# The exported surface, classified.  Generated by `./tools/check/exports.janet`;
# do not edit.
#
# `class` is decided by two facts and no reading: whether a built native
# module requires the symbol, and whether the retired `janet.h` marked
# the declaration `JANET_API`.  `published` is what `module.zig` declares
# **plus what a module's undefined-symbol set actually names**, which is
# not the same list -- `raise.zig` reaches two `janet_zig_*` symbols
# through `cabi` and a module that defines a cfunction needs both;
# `compat` is the rest of `JANET_API`, retained while whether
# Claret publishes an embedding interface is undecided; `residue` was
# never public even in C, because `-fvisibility=hidden` and an internal
# header are what the C build said about it.
#
# A row whose `audience` reads `only:<tags>` is a **conditional export**:
# the default native build does not publish it and the configurations
# named do. That population is read from `tools/check/gated.txt` rather
# than measured here, so it is as fresh as the last `gates.janet` run.
#
# `header` is where the name was declared; `audience` is every place in
# this tree that reaches the symbol through the symbol table rather than
# by import.  A residue row with an empty audience has no caller of any
# kind and is what increment 2b retires.
#
# headers read from  17b3f8c4
#
# published       25
# compat         409
# residue          0
# linker           2
# total          436
#
# residue with no audience at all  0
#
# columns: class  name  header  audience
